_about: AA-642 S263 E2 TripPlanner prompt register manifest (same format and hash as AA-CIS-App shared/llm_client/prompt_versions.json). One entry per (stage, version), newest last. prompt_sha256 = sha256 of the source text of the symbols (backend/shared/prompt_registry.prompt_hash_of). Changing a prompt: run python3 backend/scripts/prompt_registry_check.py --bump; AA-CIS-App registers the rows in its prompt register. Never edit an existing entry.
